text: Controlled drugs carry legal records. One person reviews them across every office, and that's this role.
The one thing to remember: the Controlled Substances Director oversees controlled drugs in every office: counts, shrink, the activity log and the Vet Snap export.
This is Drew, our Controlled Substances Director. No Catalog or Settings.
It opens to inventory: shrink and accuracy, counts, the controlled-drug report, and activity.
And it shows controlled drugs only.
The Vet Snap patient and client file for the DEA log also downloads from the Controlled Drugs report.
Drew can open client and patient records to follow up on a dose, but this role alone doesn't sign, count or dispense.
The most common mistake is expecting this role to sign or count by itself. It reviews; techs and vets count and dispense.
Remember: the Controlled Substances Director oversees controlled drugs in every office.
